item.title: Birthday bash at Bowen Museum
item.description: MISHAWAKA, Ind. -- Bethel University will celebrate the birthday of former Governor of Indiana, Dr. Otis R. Bowen, at the "Bowen Birthday Bash" on Feb. 26 from 1 to 3 p.m. in the Bowen Museum, located in the Otis and Elizabeth Bowen Library building on Bethel's campus.

item.title: 20-year-old man found shot in apartment in Elkhart
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- The Elkhart Police Department confirmed they are actively investigating a shooting with injuries that occurred in the 500 block of Viriginia Street Saturday morning.

item.title: Two-vehicle collision at the intersection of Grape and Douglas Road
item.description: MISHAWAKA, Ind. -- The Mishawaka Fire IAFF confirmed Saturday evening that Engine 3B was dispatched for a motor vehicle collision at the intersection of Grape and Douglas Road.

item.title: Mishawaka Police respond to false gunshot claim at UP Mall
item.description: MISHAWAKA, Ind. -- Mishawaka Police Department confirmed at approximately 4:50 p.m. on Saturday, a private security officer was notified of a fight near the center court area inside of UP Mall.

item.title: St. Joseph County Assessor holds Town Hall as 2025 property tax appeals near completion
item.description: LAKEVILLE, Ind. -- The first of several planned town halls hosted by the St. Joseph County Assessor's Office drew residents to Lakeville on Saturday, offering help with property tax assessments and appeals ahead of the spring 2026 tax season.

item.title: Goshen Theater hosts 1920s themed soiree
item.description: GOSHEN, Ind. -- Goshen Theatre is hosting a 19020s themed party, titled Moonlight and Moonshine: A Speakeasy Soiree, on Saturday, Feb 28, from 8:30 p.m. to 11 pm.

item.title: Ten African American Heroes honored at special ribbon cutting
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- Ten African American heroes from Elkhart County were highlighted and told their life stories at the ribbon cutting of the House of Heros legacy room on Saturday.

item.title: La Porte County Commissioner addresses rumors at Data Center meeting
item.description: LAPORTE COUNTY, Ind. -- The Laporte County Commissioner, Steve Holifield, held a meeting Saturday to discuss the rumors of a data center being built.

item.title: Former Purdue wide receiver, Rondale Moore, dead at 25
item.description: NEW ALBANY, Ind. -- Former Purdue and NFL wide receiver Rondale Moore died Saturday according to ESPN.
